changes.to: Issue #17 (2026-11-17): IIT iCub technical specification Rev 2.5 - about 105 cm, 33 kg with battery pack (30 kg body), 53 DoF (eyes 3, head 3, chest 3, arms 7x2, hands 9x2, legs 6x2), 36 V 9 Ah (324 Wh) battery listed as not yet available. HumanoidStore's price removed: IIT quotes per request. [replaced battery_wh: None -> 324] HumanoidStore price (US$280625) removed: no maker list price confirmed.

Maker material (RobotCub leaflet and the iCub paper by IIT/Univ. of Genoa): 104 cm, 53 DoF (head 6, arms 7x2, hands 9x2, legs 6x2, waist 3), 25 kg without battery / 29 kg with battery (IIT facility documentation; weight field = 29 kg), 48 V on-board battery pack, ~4,000-point capacitive skin, YARP/ROS middleware, GPL/FDL open hardware and software. Earlier leaflets quote 22 kg. The 280,625 USD price was an aggregator conversion of a 250,000 EUR figure and was removed - IIT sells iCubs to labs by quotation.
External cluster over Gbit Ethernet (no on-board compute)

changes.from: Compact humanoid from Istituto Italiano di Tecnologia (IIT); b2b only, sold to research buyers.
changes.to: IIT's open-source child-sized iCub, the standard platform for embodied-cognition research, with 53 DoF and a full-body capacitive skin.
